notes.title: Devastator Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381677/b3b43ec1fd416ab70a49efd71d3087bc7937d88d.png[/img]

Exactly one year since the release of Planet Bounce today's DLC release brings even more new content and ships to conquer the galaxy with. Its been a great journey with our dev team and fan base and this new year, 2021, brings the exciting new Devastator pack.

We are really excited for you to have a look at the newest DLC with a long awaited 2 new ships and 3 new specialties that really change the dynamics of your combat.

The Strike Coincider has been a long work in progress and has turned out better than even the dev's were expecting with a new shape shifting design. I won't spoil any more than that, and meanwhile the Infinity Caster is exactly what everyone was always hoping for and expecting, just one massive tank of a ship.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381677/95ec5f504e8ac3b63e633a9d794b81714d1295d6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Milestone 10,000
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381677/4094130c06b35edb7ae71d6095a4326902ae1b05.png[/img]

We are very proud to announce Planet Bounce has surpassed 10,000 downloads!

This is an exciting announcement and we would like to thank all our play testers and fans. We could not have come so far without you and we are always striving to implement new suggestions and expand the game and its features.

notes.title: Vengeance Release 5.2.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381677/4094130c06b35edb7ae71d6095a4326902ae1b05.png[/img]

We are proud to announce 3 exciting developments: a milestone for our project, a new update to Planet Bounce and the release of our first DLC.

[h3][b]MILESTONE 5000 Downloads[/b][/h3]

Fist of all we are very excited to announce that we have surpassed 5000 downloads! Just 3 months having passed since Planet Bounce has come to Steam and all the support we have received has been massive.

[h3][b]UPDATE 5.2.1[/b][/h3]

Second, we have just released Planet Bounce 5.2.1. We are happy to announce the release of Russian and Spanish translations (with German soon to come) along with that most of the changes you will see are UI and campaign balancing but a lot is happening in the background! (Stay tuned for new features soon!)

[h3][b]New DLC available[/b][/h3]

Last, but definitely not least Planet Bounce has just released its first DLC. The Vengeance pack brings 3 new powerful warships to the galaxy. The Hiadran Runner is nothing short of a galactic battleship with long range weaponary that dominates in any circumstance. The Dread Streak is the fastest ship ever designed by the Fifth Armada and certainly something to be reckoned with. Lastly, the Saw Ship is a beastly ship, whose name really does tell the whole entire story.

We appreciate all you comments and thoughts and have endeavored to implement them in this update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270250

notes.title: Lunar Update 5.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381677/a02530dc015f83fb285d105463cfd84c531c0405.png[/img]

Thanks to all the feedback we have received, this update includes interface improvements and some changes to help make the game even more enjoyable.

We appreciate all you comments and thoughts and have endeavored to implement them in this update!

[h2]Key features of this update include:[/h2]
[list][*][h3][b]Campaign difficulty[/b][/h3]This update brings greater flexibility in the difficulty settings of the campaign and AI. [i]Easy[/i] is now notably easier and [i]Hard[/i] likewise appropriate for advanced players.
[*][h3][b]Interface updates[/b][/h3]Small interface changes to the tutorial, menu and campaign which helps add clarity for first time players and make the customization more intuitive.
[*][h3][b]Player feedback[/b][/h3]Implementation of the player feedback, all suggestions that haven't been massive features requests have been implemented and we are currently working on adding the larger features that have been recommended including a new Grand Finale scenario (and in the distant future online matchmaking).
[/list]

notes.title: Planet Bounce - Milestone I
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381677/2465eb4cdaf12e1aae654f589b345e22a9d930a5.png[/img]

We have reached the end of week 1 without anything blowing up or catching fire and, in fact, have had massive success. [b]We have had the massive accomplishment of reaching nearly 1000 downloads in our first 7 days![/b]

Hitting this first milestone is a huge win for a game which has grown from out of a basement to now become a full fledged space combat game.

Meanwhile, this first week we have been working in the background on cool new features which you can expect soon in the future.
[list]
[*] [b]Grand Finale (endless combat mode)[/b] [i]Soon to come![/i]
[/list]

We would like to thank all of you out there who have downloaded the game, posted on the forum or written reviews! Ultimately, this game is about you so we really appreciate your support and would love to hear your thoughts on how we can take Planet Bounce even further in the future!

notes.title: Planet Bounce Zero Hour
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381677/a2b614ff825e217fd740ec6ffe28cb6bbd9f8458.png[/img]

The hour has finally come and we are very excited to announce that Planet Bounce is available to download, completely free, from Steam!

You now get the chance to save galaxies or blow up your friends in the uniquely designed Planet Bounce universe. Play as a newly recruited scout pilot and advance through the ranks, gaining powerful unlocks until you finally become a true Grand Admiral. Take control of a variety of spacecraft and weaponry and destroy your enemy in this top-view, fast action game.

This marks Rais Software's first release of Planet Bounce on Steam. A culmination of over 2 years of work, Planet Bounce has emerged into an epic videogame coming to Steam and your PC today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1207770/Planet_Bounce/

Planet Bounce is coming to Steam and bringing with it tonnes of awesome new features:
[list]
[*][b]GALACTIC CAMPAIGNS[/b]
An extensive new campaign[b] with 29 scenarios[/b]. Fight across the galaxy against multiple alien races in an intense battle to defend and to conquer.

[*][b]100'S OF UNLOCKS[/b]
25 Ranks, 11 Ships, 10 Special Weapons, 9 Maps, 8 Galaxies and over 50 new Planets to unlock as you destroy your opponents.

[*][b]3 NEW GAMEMODES[/b]
[i]Strike, Steal,[/i] or [i]Takeover[/i] your opponents as you fight an ever changing battle. Master three unique styles of fighting with ever increasing power and weaponry.
